routes.label: Find the distance traveled per hour

question: 90 kilometers are traveled in 2 hours. How many kilometers are traveled in 4 hours at the same speed? Calculate: \(90\div2\times4=?\)
solution: At 45 kilometers per hour, the distance traveled in 4 hours is 180 kilometers.

solutionMethods.explanation: At 45 kilometers per hour, the distance traveled in 4 hours is 180 kilometers.

solutionMethods.explanation:
Four hours consists of two \(2\)-hour intervals. At the same speed, each interval covers \(90\) kilometers, so the total distance is
\[
90+90=180\text{ kilometers}.
\]
solutionMethods.label: Add two equal time intervals
